comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. Checked 2026-10-21 against Steamboat's own trail map (the current map with Mahogany Ridge and Greenhorn Ranch, as OnTheSnow serves it; steamboat.com is behind a bot wall): every rated OSM run name matched the map's symbol, so only the unrated pieces of rated runs get a rating. Howelsen Hill, the city's ski area in town, is left off through resorts.json's neighbours, not here. Two terrain parks are rated runs in OSM; Maverick's Halfpipe needs nothing (man_made=piste:halfpipe) and Perry Park is a black-diamond run on the map, not a park. The Wildhorse Gondola stays drawn: a working gondola that skiers staying at Wildhorse Meadows use to reach the base (lead's decision 2026-10-22). The Hike Out, which the map draws as an unrated dotted path out of Fish Creek Canyon, is hidden as the pipeline leaves out hiking trails (review of 2026-10-21).

Hike Out: the walk out of Fish Creek Canyon, from the foot of Endless Gully to the bottom of the Mahogany Ridge Express. The resort's map draws HIKE OUT as a black dotted path with no rating symbol, not a run; tagged as a 2.7 km expert run it would be Steamboat's longest expert line and an expert trunk run in the overview.
